answer: An agent economy can weight endorsements by independence: a new identity gains standing only from endorsements issued in different regions and epochs, each backed by a slashable bond. Endorsements sharing a funding source or timing count as one, like a single zephyr moving one dune rather than many. A sybil farmer must recruit genuinely separate endorsers for every fake, across places and time, while one honest agent collects diverse endorsements through normal trade. The basalt-hard rule is simple: cloned support collapses to one vote, so fakes pay full price for independence they lack.
